title: Continual Concept Erasure in Diffusion Models by Suppressing Cross-Edit Interference
title_zh: 通过抑制跨编辑干扰在扩散模型中实现持续概念擦除

paragraphs.en: Concept erasure removes copyright-protected, privacy-sensitive, or otherwise undesirable concepts from pretrained text-to-image diffusion models to support content governance and compliance. As erasure requests arrive over time, models must remove new targets without undoing prior erasures. Existing methods do not constrain interference across edits: residual perturbations outside the retain set interact and accumulate, degrading unrelated generations and sometimes collapsing previously erased targets into noise. We propose CEASE ( C ontinual E rasure via A daptive S ubspace E diting), a training-free method that imposes two subspace constraints on a closed-form solver. CEASE adds the token representation of the shared replacement to the solver’s invariance matrix and, when interference is detected, projects the current update onto the orthogonal complement of dominant output directions extracted from cumulative past updates. A closed-form decomposition attributes the accumulated interference to repeated activation of the shared replacement and overlap between successive update directions, showing that the two constraints suppress these respective sources. Across continual erasure of celebrities, artistic styles, and instances, CEASE achieves the most consistent erase--preserve trade-off, while existing methods either degrade general generation or insufficiently erase targets. 1 1 1 Project page: https://continual-erasure.cvmlgroup.web.illinois.edu/

(2024) to confine the effects of erasure to the target concepts. As shown in Fig. 1 (a), COCO FID on unrelated prompts rises as the number of edits increases Lin et al. (2014) . This exposes a limitation of existing preservation constraints in the continual setting: protecting a finite retain set at each step does not reliably prevent subsequent updates from cumulatively degrading general generation. Beyond image quality, this degradation also weakens the model’s ability to follow prompt semantics: Figure 1 (b) shows that, after 100 edits, the CLIP score on the same prompts falls well below that of the unedited model. This reduced ability to follow prompt semantics may also affect the outcomes of previous erasures, because the replacement outputs for earlier targets depend on the same continually updated weights. Figure 1 (c) illustrates both effects in the baseline models: they corrupt an unrelated scene and produce noise for the erased celebrity, failing to generate the prescribed generic portrait.

paragraphs.en: To suppress the accumulation of interference in continual concept erasure, we propose CEASE ( C ontinual E rasure via A daptive S ubspace E diting), a training-free method based on two subspace constraints. CEASE adds the token representation of the shared replacement to the invariance matrix of the closed-form solver, preventing subsequent updates from modifying this representation. It also extracts the dominant output directions from cumulative past updates and, when interference is detected, projects the current update onto their orthogonal complement. Theoretically, a closed-form decomposition attributes the accumulated interference to repeated activation of the shared replacement and overlap between successive update directions, and shows that the two designs suppress the respective sources. Empirically, CEASE maintains stable COCO FID throughout the edit sequence and a COCO CLIP score close to the unedited reference after 100 edits, as shown in Fig. 1 (a) and (b). Across continual erasure tasks involving celebrities, artistic styles, and instances, CEASE achieves the most consistent erase–preserve trade-off. On style erasure, CEASE reduces COCO FID by 73% relative to the strongest prior method. Our contributions are summarized as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 为了抑制持续概念擦除过程中干扰的累积，我们提出了 CEASE（C ontinual E rasure via A daptive S ubspace E diting），这是一种基于两个子空间约束、无需训练的算法。 CEASE 将共享替换项的标记表示添加到闭式求解器的不变性矩阵中，从而防止后续更新修改该表示。 它还会从累积的历史更新中提取主导输出方向，并在检测到干扰时，将当前更新投影到这些方向的正交补空间上。 理论上，闭式分解将累积的干扰归因于共享替换项的重复激活以及连续更新方向之间的重叠，并证明了这两种设计分别抑制了各自的干扰来源。 实验表明，在整个编辑序列中，CEASE 能够保持稳定的 COCO FID；经过 100 次编辑后，其 COCO CLIP 分数仍接近未编辑的参考值，如图 1 (a) 和 (b) 所示。 在涉及名人、艺术风格和具体实例的持续擦除任务中，CEASE 实现了最稳定的擦除与保留之间的平衡。 在风格擦除方面，CEASE 相较于此前最强的方法，将 COCO FID 降低了 73%。 我们的贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: We formalize how interference accumulates across edits in continual concept erasure, and derive a closed-form decomposition that attributes it to repeated activation of the shared replacement and overlap between successive update directions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将持续概念擦除过程中跨编辑的干扰累积过程形式化，并推导出一种闭式分解方法，将其归因于共享替换机制的重复激活以及连续更新方向之间的重叠。

paragraphs.en: We introduce two training-free subspace constraints: one keeps the token representation of the shared replacement invariant, while the other steers the current update away from the dominant output directions of past edits, thereby suppressing the two interference sources.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了两种无需训练的子空间约束：一种保持共享替换的标记表示不变，另一种则将当前更新引导至远离过往编辑主导输出方向的方向，从而抑制这两种干扰源。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate continual erasure of celebrities, artistic styles, and instances across multiple diffusion backbones and assess both erasure and preservation; CEASE achieves the best erase–preserve balance among the compared methods while keeping retained concepts recognizable at rates close to the reference model.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在多种扩散模型架构上评估了对名人、艺术风格及具体实例的持续擦除，并综合评估了擦除效果与保留效果；在对比的方法中，CEASE实现了最佳的擦除–保留平衡，同时使保留的概念的识别率接近参考模型。

paragraphs.en: Concept Erasure in Diffusion Models. Text-to-image diffusion models Zhang et al. (2023a) ; Ma et al. (2024) ; Ji et al. (2026) trained on uncurated web data can reproduce copyrighted styles, recognizable identities, and other undesired content, and concept erasure removes such targets from a pretrained model after training. Existing methods fall into three families. Training-based methods fine-tune the model with a concept-suppression objective and a preservation regularizer Gandikota et al. (2023) ; Zhang et al. (2024) ; Kumari et al. (2023) ; Huang et al. (2024) ; Lyu et al. (2024) ; Li et al. (2024) ; Kim et al. (2024) ; Zhao et al. (2024) ; Wu et al. (2025) , with a separate strand hardening the erasure against adversarial prompts Fan et al. (2024) ; Heng and Soh (2023) ; Pham et al. (2024) ; Park et al. (2024) ; their common cost is that each new target requires another fine-tuning loop. Editing-based methods instead update cross-attention projections through a closed-form least-squares solution, from TIME Orgad et al. (2023) and UCE Gandikota et al. (2024) to MACE Lu et al. (2024) , RECE Gong et al. (2024) , and SPEED Li et al. (2026) ; they edit the model in seconds, but their preservation depends on a finite retain set. Non-parametric methods leave the weights untouched and intervene at sampling time Schramowski et al. (2023) ; Das et al. (2024) ; Rando et al. (2022) . All three families are typically evaluated with the full target set known before editing; our study instead evaluates repeated application to an already-edited model.

paragraphs.en: Sequential Unlearning. Sequential unlearning is closely related to continual learning and online learning Liu et al. (2020) ; Liu et al. (2021a) ; Liu et al. (2021b) ; Liu et al. (2023a) ; Liu et al. (2023b) ; Liu et al. (2024) ; Li et al. (2019) ; Li et al. (2020) ; Li et al. (2021) ; Luo et al. (2023) ; Fischer et al. (2024) ; Zhang et al. (2023b) . While continual learning and online learning typically focus on acquiring new knowledge without forgetting, sequential unlearning poses the complementary challenge of repeatedly removing targeted knowledge without causing unintended forgetting of retained concepts. In deployment, takedown demands and right-to-be-forgotten obligations arrive as a stream. For language models, the locate-then-edit paradigm Meng et al. (2022a) ; Meng et al. (2022b) degrades under repeated application, and mitigations include drift-restraining regularizers Ma et al. (2025) ; Gu et al. (2024) , external edit memories Hartvigsen et al. (2023) ; Wang et al. (2024b) , and projections onto the null space of preserved keys Fang et al. (2025) ; these approaches operate on factual associations, where edits do not share a common redirection target. For diffusion models, Selective Amnesia Heng and Soh (2023) first cast concept forgetting as a continual-learning problem, and later work adds concept-aware masking with distillation Li et al. (2025) , gradient projection against semantically related concepts Lee et al. (2026) , and multi-objective distillation across deletion requests George et al. (2025) ; these methods suppress the degradation as a monolithic quantity without analyzing where it comes from. In contrast, we approach continual erasure from the perspective of cross-edit interference: we trace the failure to the interference that successive edits accumulate on unprotected prompts, and design our method to suppress this interference.

(2026) ，以及跨删除请求的多目标蒸馏 George et al. (2025) ；这些方法将性能下降视为一个整体量进行抑制，而未分析其具体来源。 相比之下，我们从跨编辑干扰的角度出发处理持续擦除问题：我们追溯性能下降的根源，发现它源于连续编辑在未经保护的提示上累积的干扰，并据此设计了抑制这种干扰的方法。

paragraphs.en: Baselines and Benchmarks. We evaluate on three concept erasure benchmarks adapted from MACE Lu et al. (2024) and SPEED Li et al. (2026) , covering celebrities, artistic styles, and object or character instances. Each benchmark pairs 100 erased concepts with 100 disjoint retained concepts and uses five prompt templates per concept. We compare two groups of baselines: standard erasure methods, comprising the closed-form SPEED Li et al. (2026) , UCE Gandikota et al. (2024) , and RECE Gong et al. (2024) and the training-based ESD Gandikota et al. (2023) and ConAbl Kumari et al. (2023) , and continual-unlearning methods, comprising CUIG-GradProj Lee et al. (2026) and Sculpting Memory Li et al. (2025) .
paragraphs.zh: 基线方法与基准测试。 我们在三个概念擦除基准测试上进行了评估，这些测试改编自 MACE Lu et al. (2024) 和 SPEED Li et al. paragraphs.en: Metrics. We report CLIP score (CS) ( Hessel et al., 2021 ) for image–prompt alignment, and FID ( Heusel et al., 2017 ) and LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) for the distribution-level and image-level distance from the unedited backbone’s generations, on each of the erase set, the retain set, and 1,000 MS-COCO captions. On the erase and retain sets we add one task-matched fourth metric. For celebrities, Acc is the recognition accuracy of an open-ended VLM judge (Qwen2-VL-7B) Wang et al. (2024a) asked to name the person in the image; for instances, Acc is the CLIP zero-shot top-1 accuracy against the 200 concept candidates; both should drop on the erase set and stay high on the retain set. For styles, the LAION aesthetic score (Aes) ( Schuhmann et al., 2022 ) is a no-reference quality rating on a 1–10 scale that should stay near the unedited reference.
paragraphs.zh: 指标。我们报告了图像与提示对齐的 CLIP 分数（CS）（Hessel 等，2021），以及用于评估与未经编辑的主模型生成结果在分布层面和图像层面的距离的 FID（Heusel 等，2017）和 LPIPS（Zhang 等，2018），这些指标均在擦除集、保留集以及 1,000 个 MS-COCO 图像描述上计算。在擦除集和保留集中，我们还增加了一个与任务匹配的第四个指标。对于名人图像，Acc 是一个开放式视觉语言模型（VLM）评判器（Qwen2-VL-7B）（Wang 等，2024a）的识别准确率，该模型被要求指出图像中的人物；对于实例图像，Acc 则是与 200 个候选概念进行 CLIP 零样本分类时的 top-1 准确率；这两个指标在擦除集中均应下降，而在保留集中应保持较高水平。对于风格图像，LAION 美学分数（Aes）（Schuhmann 等，2022）是一个无参考质量评分，范围从 1 到 10，该分数应保持在接近未经编辑的参考值水平。

Across all three tasks, CEASE achieves the most favorable balance between erasure and preservation: it substantially alters the erased concepts while keeping the retained concepts and unrelated generation close to the unedited model, whereas the baselines that erase more deeply do so by corrupting the retain set or MS-COCO prompts as well. Results on the Stable Diffusion v1.5 and v2.1 backbones appear in Appendices A.3 and A.4 , with the same conclusions.

paragraphs.en: Erasure of Celebrities. As shown in Table 1 , continually applying SPEED severely degrades general generation, with quality on both the retain set and COCO deteriorating as edits accumulate. CEASE performs best among the edited methods on nearly all retain and COCO preservation metrics, and the VLM judge almost never names the erased celebrities while still recognizing most of the retained ones. UCE and RECE obtain the lowest erase-set CLIP scores, but their retain-set scores collapse to a similar degree, indicating prompt-independent corruption rather than selective removal; ESD, in contrast, leaves a noticeable fraction of the erased identities recognizable.
paragraphs.zh: 名人的抹除。 如表 1 所示，持续应用 SPEED 会严重损害通用生成能力，随着编辑的累积，保留集和 COCO 上的质量均有所下降。 在几乎所有保留集和 COCO 的保留指标中，CEASE 在编辑方法中的表现最佳；VLM 判评员几乎从未提及被抹除的名人，同时仍能识别出大多数被保留的名人。 UCE 和 RECE 获得了最低的擦除集 CLIP 分数，但它们的保留集分数也以相似程度崩溃，表明这是提示无关的损坏，而非选择性移除；相比之下，ESD 仍让一部分被抹除的身份具有明显的可识别性。

sents.en: As shown in Table 1 , continually applying SPEED severely degrades general generation, with quality on both the retain set and COCO deteriorating as edits accumulate.
sents.zh: 如表 1 所示，持续应用 SPEED 会严重损害通用生成能力，随着编辑的累积，保留集和 COCO 上的质量均有所下降。

sents.en: CEASE performs best among the edited methods on nearly all retain and COCO preservation metrics, and the VLM judge almost never names the erased celebrities while still recognizing most of the retained ones.
sents.zh: 在几乎所有保留集和 COCO 的保留指标中，CEASE 在编辑方法中的表现最佳；VLM 判评员几乎从未提及被抹除的名人，同时仍能识别出大多数被保留的名人。

sents.en: UCE and RECE obtain the lowest erase-set CLIP scores, but their retain-set scores collapse to a similar degree, indicating prompt-independent corruption rather than selective removal; ESD, in contrast, leaves a noticeable fraction of the erased identities recognizable.
sents.zh: UCE 和 RECE 获得了最低的擦除集 CLIP 分数，但它们的保留集分数也以相似程度崩溃，表明这是提示无关的损坏，而非选择性移除；相比之下，ESD 仍让一部分被抹除的身份具有明显的可识别性。

paragraphs.en: Erasure of Styles. Table 2 shows the style task to be SPEED’s most severe failure, whereas CEASE remains best among the edited methods on all retain metrics and on COCO CLIP score. Sculpting Memory attains lower COCO FID, but at the cost of a substantially more degraded retain set. Importantly, the preservation gain of CEASE does not come from leaving the erased styles unchanged: it still lowers the erase-set CLIP score substantially, and its erase-set aesthetic score stays at the reference level, showing that the redirected outputs remain coherent paintings, whereas RECE and CUIG-GradProj produce aesthetically collapsed images.
paragraphs.zh: 风格的消除。 表 2 显示，在风格任务中，SPEED 的表现最差，而 CEASE 在所有保留指标以及 COCO CLIP 分数上仍是所有编辑方法中的最佳选择。 Sculpting Memory 的 COCO FID 较低，但代价是保留集的质量显著下降。 重要的是，CEASE 的保留效果并非源于对已消除风格的保留：它仍然会大幅降低消除集的 CLIP 分数，且其消除集的美学评分维持在参考水平，这表明重定向后的输出仍然是连贯的画作，而 RECE 和 CUIG-GradProj 则生成了美学上退化的图像。

paragraphs.en: Qualitative Results. Figure 3 compares all methods on the erased target “Hillary Clinton”, the retained concept “Jason Statham”, and an unrelated MS-COCO prompt. RECE, UCE, and CUIG-GradProj collapse all three categories alike to black or noise; SPEED and ConAbl distort the erased identity and, like Sculpting Memory, replace the retained one; ESD leaves the erased target fully recognizable. In contrast, CEASE redirects the target to a coherent anchor substitute while leaving the retained concept and the COCO scene visually intact. More visualization results on the celebrity, style, and instance tasks, as well as on the Stable Diffusion v1.5 and v2.1 backbones, are provided in Appendix A.7 , we observe the same pattern in those settings.
paragraphs.zh: 定性结果。 图 3 比较了所有方法在擦除目标“Hillary Clinton”、保留概念“Jason Statham”以及一个无关的 MS-COCO 提示词上的表现。 RECE、UCE 和 CUIG-GradProj 将这三个类别同样地坍缩为黑色或噪声；SPEED 和 ConAbl 扭曲了被擦除的身份，并且像 Sculpting Memory 一样替换了保留的概念；ESD 则让被擦除的目标完全可识别。 相比之下，CEASE 将目标重定向到一个连贯的锚点替代物，同时保留了保留概念和 COCO 场景的视觉完整性。 关于名人、风格和实例任务，以及 Stable Diffusion v1.5 和 v2.1 背骨模型上的更多可视化结果，请参见附录 A.7；我们在这些设置中也观察到了相同的模式。

paragraphs.en: Cross-Edit Interference over the Sequence. Figure 5 traces the value-projection interference of SPEED, RECE with one adversarial epoch per request, UCE, and CEASE over the 100-step celebrity sequence. For SPEED, interference grows steadily on unrelated COCO prompts, on the shared replacement, and on the erased target, and the target curve rises sharply in the final edits. RECE exceeds the displayed range within the first ten edits and ends several orders of magnitude higher, consistent with its COCO FID in Fig. 1 (a). CEASE stays below SPEED on all three diagnostics; on the shared replacement it remains near zero, which is the direct effect of AIC. UCE is the exception that shows the limits of this diagnostic: its final interference on the shared replacement is three orders of magnitude above CEASE, while its unscaled COCO and target values end slightly lower despite far worse generation quality (the displayed UCE curve is scaled by a factor of two and ends above CEASE), so value-projection interference alone does not rank preservation across methods. Figure 13 reports the COCO CLIP score and the target-averaged diagnostic at five checkpoints; relative to SPEED, CEASE keeps a higher CLIP score and lower FID at every checkpoint. The underlying measurements use saved checkpoints from complete sequential runs; UCE is displayed with the stated post-processing scale; the projection diagnostic is interpreted separately from generation quality (Appendix A.8 ).
paragraphs.zh: 序列上的跨编辑干扰。 图 5 追踪了 SPEED、RECE（每次请求一个对抗性轮次）、UCE 和 CEASE 在 100 步名人序列上的价值投影干扰。 对于 SPEED，干扰在未相关的 COCO 提示、共享替换部分以及被擦除的目标上持续增加，且目标曲线在最后几次编辑中急剧上升。 RECE 在前十次编辑内就超过了显示范围，最终数值高出几个数量级，这与图 1(a) 中的其 COCO FID 结果一致。 CEASE 在所有三项诊断指标上的表现均低于 SPEED；在共享替换部分，其值接近于零，这是 AIC 的直接效果。 UCE 是这一诊断方法的例外，它揭示了该方法的局限性：其在共享替换部分上的最终干扰比 CEASE 高出三个数量级，而其未经缩放的 COCO 和目标值尽管生成质量远差，最终却略低（图中显示的 UCE 曲线乘以了 2 的缩放因子，且最终值高于 CEASE），因此仅凭价值投影干扰无法对方法间的保留能力进行排序。 图 13 报告了五个检查点处的 COCO CLIP 分数和以目标为平均的诊断指标；与 SPEED 相比，CEASE 在每个检查点都保持了更高的 CLIP 分数和更低的 FID。 底层测量使用了完整序列运行中保存的检查点；UCE 显示了声明的后处理缩放比例；投影诊断与生成质量分开解读（附录 A.8）。

paragraphs.en: In addition, we analyze the robustness of CEASE to the erasure order in Appendix A.5 , and compare its computational efficiency with all baselines in Appendix A.6 .
paragraphs.zh: 此外，我们在附录 A.5 中分析了 CEASE 对删除顺序的鲁棒性，并在附录 A.6 中将其计算效率与所有基线方法进行了比较。

paragraphs.en: We studied continual concept erasure, where deletion requests arrive one after another and each edit builds on all previous ones. We traced the severe degradation of existing methods in this regime to accumulating cross-edit interference, and proposed CEASE, a training-free framework that protects the shared anchor and steers each new update away from the directions perturbed by past edits. Experiments on erasing celebrities, artistic styles, and instances across multiple backbones show that CEASE achieves the most consistent erase–preserve trade-off.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了持续概念擦除问题，其中删除请求依次到达，每次编辑都基于所有先前的编辑。 我们追踪到现有方法在此场景下性能严重下降的原因在于跨编辑干扰的累积，并提出了 CEASE——一个无需训练的框架，它能保护共享锚点，并使每次新更新偏离受过往编辑扰动的影响方向。 在多个基础模型上对名人、艺术风格及具体实例进行擦除的实验表明，CEASE 实现了最稳定的擦除与保留之间的平衡。

sents.en: Experiments on erasing celebrities, artistic styles, and instances across multiple backbones show that CEASE achieves the most consistent erase–preserve trade-off.
sents.zh: 在多个基础模型上对名人、艺术风格及具体实例进行擦除的实验表明，CEASE 实现了最稳定的擦除与保留之间的平衡。

paragraphs.en: Limitations. First, our experiments focus on the Stable Diffusion family, and extending CEASE to more recent architectures such as FLUX is a natural next step. Second, this work instantiates the proposed constraints in a closed-form solver, and generalizing them to training-based erasure methods is left to future work. Third, our sequences contain up to 100 edits; evaluating substantially longer streams is conceptually straightforward but computationally expensive, since every additional step requires regenerating and re-evaluating thousands of images.
paragraphs.zh: 局限性。 首先，我们的实验聚焦于 Stable Diffusion 系列模型，将 CEASE 扩展到 FLUX 等更新的架构是顺理成章的下一步。 其次，本研究以闭式求解器实现了所提出的约束条件，而将其推广至基于训练的擦除方法则留待未来研究。 第三，我们的序列最多包含 100 次编辑；评估明显更长的序列在概念上很简单，但计算成本高昂，因为每一步的额外操作都需要重新生成和评估数千张图像。

paragraphs.en: We repeat the full 100-step sequence on Stable Diffusion v1.5, a second CLIP-L backbone, for all tasks and baselines, and report the results in Tables 5 , 6 , and 7 . The erase–preserve pattern of the main results transfers: CEASE improves the retain and COCO preservation metrics over SPEED on all three tasks while still altering the erased targets, and its aesthetic scores on styles stay at the reference level. paragraphs.zh: 我们对所有任务和基线模型在 Stable Diffusion v1.5 和第二个 CLIP-L 骨干网络上重复执行完整的 100 步序列，并将结果报告于表 5、6 和 7 中。 主要结果的“擦除–保留”模式具有迁移性：在所有三项任务中，CEASE 在保留和 COCO 保留指标上优于 SPEED，同时仍然会改变被擦除的目标，且其在不同风格上的美学评分仍保持在参考水平。 擦除程度更深的基线模型在保留效果上付出了代价：ConAbl 在名人识别和风格保留方面的 COCO FID 较低，但基本破坏了所保留的概念；而 UCE 和 RECE 的擦除程度最深，导致保留集合完全崩溃。

paragraphs.en: Stable Diffusion v2.1 replaces the CLIP-L text encoder with the 1024-dimensional OpenCLIP-H and is the hardest tested backbone: every method erases more weakly, and the margins narrow accordingly (Tables 8 , 9 , and 10 ). CEASE still improves the retain and COCO preservation metrics over SPEED on all three tasks, whereas some baselines preserve well only because they barely erase: UCE leaves most of the erased celebrities recognizable, and ESD leaves the erased instances nearly intact. Overall, the transfer study supports a consistent preservation advantage over the underlying SPEED solver across both text encoders, at the cost of shallower erasure on several tasks.
paragraphs.zh: Stable Diffusion v2.1 将 CLIP-L 文本编码器替换为 1024 维的 OpenCLIP-H，并且是测试难度最高的基础模型：所有方法的擦除效果都较弱，因此差异也相应缩小（表 8、9 和 10）。 在所有三项任务中，CEASE 在保留率和 COCO 保留指标上仍优于 SPEED，而某些基线模型之所以能良好保留内容，仅仅是因为它们几乎未进行擦除：UCE 让大多数被擦除的名人形象仍然可识别，而 ESD 则让被擦除的实例几乎保持原样。 总体而言，这项迁移研究支持 CEASE 在两种文本编码器下都比底层的 SPEED 求解器具有更一致的保留优势，但代价是在若干任务中擦除效果较弱。

paragraphs.en: This section provides qualitative comparisons beyond the single case shown in the main text. paragraphs.en: The failure modes match the quantitative results and the main-text analysis. On the erased rows, CEASE redirects each target to a coherent anchor substitute, whereas ESD often leaves the erased identity or style still recognizable, and RECE, UCE, and CUIG-GradProj collapse to noise-like textures once the sequence is long. Sculpting Memory remains photorealistic but drifts to subjects unrelated to either the target or its anchor. On the retained and COCO rows, the picture inverts: the destructive baselines corrupt concepts they were never asked to erase, SPEED preserves some cases but degrades others as its accumulated interference grows, and CEASE stays visually closest to the reference across both row blocks. The v1.5 and v2.1 figures show the same pattern, confirming that these behaviors are properties of the continual setting rather than of the v1.4 backbone.
paragraphs.zh: 失效模式与定量结果及正文分析一致。 在被擦除的行中，CEASE 将每个目标重定向到一个连贯的锚点替代物，而 ESD 常常使被擦除的身份或风格仍然可识别；一旦序列变长，RECE、UCE 和 CUIG-GradProj 则会坍缩为类似噪声的纹理。 “塑造记忆”模式仍保持照片级真实感，但会偏离到与目标或其锚点均无关的主题。 在保留行和 COCO 行中，情况则正好相反：破坏性基线模型会损坏它们从未被要求擦除的概念；SPEED 在某些情况下能保留效果，但随着累积干扰的增加，其他情况则会恶化；而 CEASE 在这两个行块中都与参考图像在视觉上最为接近。 v1.5 和 v2.1 的图表显示出相同的模式，证实了这些行为是持续设置本身的特性，而非 v1.4 基础模型的特性。
